body:
_Verify that the forgotten password function and other recovery paths do not reveal the current password and that the new password is not sent in clear text to the user._

**"new password is not sent in clear text to the user"**

This does not assist with sending one time password reset link, which is typically sent over SMTP in the clear. 

I think this needs to be a little more explicit.
title: 2.17 - too broad and may be misinterpreted
